content.value: Write down the relation in direction cosine between two cartesian coordinate systems (x, y, z) and $( x ^ { \prime } , y ^ { \prime } , z ^ { \prime } )$ which have same origin but rotated an angle θ. Given a vector (1, 1, 1)t, using 4 × 4 matrix operator, shift it uniformly 3 units in positive direction, then using $3 \times 3$ matrix rotational operator, rotate it $9 0 ^ { \circ }$ in anti-clockwise about x axis and finally scale it unequally with 2, 3 and 4 along $x , y ,$ and z axis respectively. Draw original and modified vectors after each operation. If the order of matrix operators are changed – are the modified points have same position as previous one, why?
(Answer ANY THREE questions from this section in Script B)
